attributes.description: Overview of the TrueNAS audit records collected by the TrueNAS integration: middleware API calls and authentications, SMB sessions and file operations, sudo command execution, and system login events. Every panel is scoped to the truenas.audit dataset.

embeddableConfig.description: Audit records with event.outcome: failure, for example a rejected sudo command or a failed SMB or middleware authentication.

embeddableConfig.description: event.action is composed as <service>-<event>, for example smb-create or middleware-method-call.
file.path is only recorded for the SMB operations that name a file, such as create, rename, unlink and set-acl.
Outcome success corresponds to sudo-accept and failure to sudo-reject.
